title: Cosmic Ballet Dream
description: Two ballerinas in green and pink tutus dance gracefully in a swirling cosmic vortex, one holding a broom with golden sparks. A green dragon, blue cat head, green fish, and colorful planets orbit around them on a vibrant geometric tiled floor.
prompt: Two graceful ballerinas, one in a sparkling green tutu floating above and one in a layered pink tutu performing a split on the ground, dance together in a vibrant swirling cosmic vortex filled with stars, colorful planets, and nebulae. A small green dragon with wings sits nearby holding a glowing orb, while a blue cat head and a green fish-like creature float in the swirling orange and purple sky above. The scene is set on a colorful geometric tiled floor with intricate patterns, in a highly detailed whimsical fantasy style.
